note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.geometry.node module functions.

method_groups.pos: pos, pos_x, pos_y, pos_z, set_pos, set_pos_x, set_pos_y, set_pos_z

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the geometry node extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the geometry node group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: node.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the geometry node. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this geometry node is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: node.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the geometry node is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the geometry node node location (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the geometry node node location.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the geometry node node location.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the geometry node node location.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the geometry node extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: node.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the geometry node group name in a given slot.

methods.name: set_pos
methods.description: Set the geometry node node location (vector).

methods.name: set_pos_x
methods.description: Set the x-component of the geometry node node location.

methods.name: set_pos_y
methods.description: Set the y-component of the geometry node node location.

methods.name: set_pos_z
methods.description: Set the z-component of the geometry node node location.

methods.name: start_edge
methods.description: Get the first edge connected to a geometry node.

methods.name: start_index
methods.description: Get the local index of the geometry node within the first edge attached to it.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this geometry node is live.
